text: Hello, I wanted to share my experience of coming back to Israel with a digitally extended visa (my visa in the passport expired in March and I was in Israel in the extension day and got a message on the phone). Yesterday I flew from Larnaca, in the airport they asked to have a proof of an address in Israel, I showed the visa in my passport and the message from PIBA on the phone. They took a photo of both, checked thoroughly my hand luggage, asked usual questions and I could check in. In Ben Gurion I couldn't print the entry paper from the machine, but I was advised to go to the border control, where the clerk printed it and didn't ask any questions. So all in all it went smoothly. Maybe someone will find it useful for their situation :)
